mission: Build a lawful worldwide partnership network connecting Christian television, Gospel radio, ministries, creators and distributors.

radio_to_tv_bridge.purpose: Allow authorised Gospel radio partners to contribute audio programming, interviews, worship sessions, music programmes and live events into YHVH's broader media ecosystem.

rules: Payment does not guarantee airtime or editorial approval.
Partnership does not constitute endorsement of every programme or ministry statement.
No content is distributed until applicable rights and territory requirements are cleared.
Local licensing and broadcasting requirements remain the responsibility of the relevant parties.
Creator ownership is preserved by default unless a written agreement states otherwise.
No VPN, proxy or technical route may be used to bypass law, licensing, geo-rights or platform controls.
All active partnerships require an auditable agreement and technical/rights status.
discovery_note: Public radio directories can identify prospects, but directory listing is not evidence of ownership, rights, licensing or partnership authorization. Each prospect must be independently verified before contact and activation.
